title: Add test for case-insensitive header lookup

rationale: Simple test case addition.

rationale: Prose editing in security guidelines.

title: Add JSON export feature to data export CLI
body: Implement a --json flag in the CLI export command that outputs filtered records as JSON instead of CSV.
rationale: Requires modifying CLI argument parser, adding JSON serialization logic, and writing integration tests.

title: Implement rate limiting middleware for REST API endpoints
body: Add token-bucket rate limiting middleware to prevent brute force attacks on the /api/v1/login endpoint.
rationale: Requires state tracking with Redis or memory store, middleware injection, and header management.

title: Add pagination support to user list endpoint
body: Add page and per_page query parameters with Link headers to GET /api/v1/users to prevent memory spikes.
rationale: Requires modifying database queries with offset/limit and formatting pagination metadata.

title: Optimize database query in report generation service
body: The monthly report query performs N+1 queries. Refactor using joinedload or select_related to improve latency.
rationale: Requires database profiling, ORM optimization, and verifying result correctness.

title: Implement JWT authentication refresh token rotation
body: When access token expires, allow client to exchange refresh token and invalidate the old refresh token.
rationale: Requires cryptographic token validation, database token blacklist, and auth flow handling.

title: Add webhook notification dispatcher on issue creation
body: Send an HTTP POST webhook with issue payload whenever a new issue is submitted by a user.
rationale: Requires asynchronous background worker or HTTP client with retry backoff.

title: Refactor date parsing logic into reusable utility module
body: Several modules parse ISO timestamps with inconsistent formats. Consolidate into a robust parse_datetime helper.
rationale: Requires refactoring multiple call sites and adding comprehensive date format tests.

title: Implement CSV import validation with error line reporting
body: When importing CSV, validate row columns against schema and return specific row numbers and error reasons for invalid records.
rationale: Requires tabular data parsing, error accumulation, and structured response generation.

title: Add caching layer to exchange rate converter service
body: Cache foreign exchange rates in memory with 1-hour TTL to avoid third-party API rate limits.
rationale: Requires implementing TTL cache, cache invalidation, and fallback logic on network error.

title: Support custom headers in HTTP client wrapper
body: Allow callers of ApiClient to pass extra HTTP headers per request and merge them with default session headers.
rationale: Requires updating client request lifecycle and header merging logic.

title: Implement role-based access control for admin dashboard
body: Restrict dashboard routes so that only users with role='admin' can perform delete and export actions.
rationale: Requires user session role checking, decorator/middleware protection, and test coverage.

title: Add search filter by date range to audit logs
body: Allow querying audit log entries between start_date and end_date using indexed database columns.
rationale: Requires updating API query parameters, SQL filtering, and index verification.

title: Implement exponential backoff retry for external payment gateway
body: When payment processor returns 503 or network timeout, retry up to 3 times with exponential backoff and jitter.
rationale: Requires implementing resilient retry decorator with jitter and error propagation.

title: Add multipart file upload endpoint with MIME type validation
body: Create endpoint allowing image uploads up to 5MB, validating file signature against allowed MIME types.
rationale: Requires streaming request handling, file validation, and cloud storage integration.

title: Implement Prometheus metrics exporter for HTTP latency
body: Expose a /metrics endpoint tracking request duration histograms and response status code counters.
rationale: Requires metrics library instrumentation and middleware hook integration.

title: Add database migration script for adding user preferences column
body: Write Alembic migration adding a nullable JSON column 'preferences' to user table with rollback support.
rationale: Requires schema migration creation, data validation, and upgrade/downgrade testing.

title: Implement OAuth2 Google login flow
body: Integrate Google OAuth2 authentication flow including authorization code exchange and user profile linking.
rationale: Requires OAuth client implementation, redirect URL handling, and session management.

title: Add PDF export support using ReportLab template
body: Generate downloadable PDF invoices from transaction models using formatted template layout.
rationale: Requires binary stream generation, styling, and multi-page layout logic.

title: Refactor monolithic app.py into blueprint modules
body: Split 1000-line single file app into modular blueprints for auth, billing, and dashboard.
rationale: Requires decoupling shared dependencies and reorganizing application factory.

title: Implement full-text search index for blog posts
body: Add SQLite FTS5 or PostgreSQL tsvector indexing for post title and content to support fast search queries.
rationale: Requires search indexing configuration, query parsing, and search result ranking.

title: Add automated database backup task to Celery scheduler
body: Create periodic Celery beat task that dumps database and uploads encrypted archive to S3.
rationale: Requires task scheduling, shell subprocess execution, and cloud storage upload.

title: Implement WebSocket notification channel for real-time chat
body: Add WebSocket handler to broadcast chat messages to connected room participants with heartbeat ping/pong.
rationale: Requires asynchronous event handling, connection state management, and disconnection cleanup.

title: Validate OpenAPI 3.0 schema generation against endpoint responses
body: Add test asserting that generated OpenAPI JSON spec matches actual API endpoint response schemas.
rationale: Requires schema introspection and recursive validation.

title: Implement password reset flow with time-limited tokens
body: Send email with HMAC-signed token expiring in 15 minutes allowing users to securely reset forgotten password.
rationale: Requires cryptographic token generation, email templating, and verification endpoint.

title: Optimize Docker image size using multi-stage build
body: Refactor Dockerfile to use multi-stage build, reducing final production image from 900MB to 120MB.
rationale: Requires build dependency separation and minimal base image configuration.

title: Design and implement distributed lock manager using Raft consensus
body: Implement distributed mutex with leader election and lease renewal across a multi-node cluster using Raft.
rationale: Requires deep understanding of distributed consensus, split-brain mitigation, and network partition recovery.

title: Resolve race condition and memory deadlock in asyncio connection pool
body: Connections in pool become orphaned under heavy concurrent load leading to deadlock in event loop worker threads.
rationale: Requires thread/asyncio synchronization analysis, core dump inspection, and lock-free queue primitives.

title: Implement zero-copy network packet parser using memory-mapped buffers
body: Optimize packet processing pipeline to avoid kernel-to-user memory copies using eBPF and AF_XDP sockets.
rationale: Requires low-level memory management, C/Cython extensions, and Linux socket programming.

title: Write custom LLVM compiler optimization pass for dead code elimination
body: Implement an LLVM pass that analyzes control flow graph and removes unreachable basic blocks in JIT compiler.
rationale: Requires compiler intermediate representation (IR) analysis and graph theory.

title: Implement zero-knowledge SNARK proof verification for private transactions
body: Implement on-chain verification algorithm for Groth16 zk-SNARK cryptographic proofs over BN254 elliptic curve.
rationale: Requires advanced abstract algebra, pairing-friendly elliptic curves, and cryptographic verification.

title: Redesign core storage engine from B-Tree to Log-Structured Merge (LSM) Tree
body: Replace database storage engine with LSM-Tree architecture featuring MemTable, WAL, SSTables, and compaction.
rationale: Requires designing disk serialization, bloom filters, merge compaction, and crash recovery.

title: Debug memory corruption and segmentation fault in C-extension garbage collector
body: C-extension crashes randomly with SIGSEGV during cyclic garbage collection under high concurrency.
rationale: Requires Valgrind/ASan profiling, GDB analysis, and Python C-API reference counting semantics.

title: Implement lock-free multi-producer multi-consumer (MPMC) ring buffer
body: Design high-throughput MPMC queue utilizing atomic compare-and-swap (CAS) operations and cache-line padding.
rationale: Requires memory ordering semantics (acquire/release), cache coherency understanding, and atomic operations.

title: Refactor monolithic microkernel IPC subsystem for capability-based security
body: Replace legacy message passing with microkernel capability-based security tokens and hardware memory page isolation.
rationale: Requires OS architecture design, page table manipulation, and formal security boundary verification.

title: Implement time-series database columnar compression algorithm (Gorilla XOR)
body: Implement Facebook Gorilla floating-point XOR delta compression for high-frequency sensor time-series data.
rationale: Requires bit-level manipulation, floating point IEEE 754 encoding, and stream decompression.

title: Design Byzantine Fault Tolerant (BFT) state machine replication engine
body: Implement PBFT consensus algorithm resilient to malicious or Byzantine nodes with view change protocol.
rationale: Requires complex distributed state machine, view change timeout handling, and cryptographic signing.

title: Implement hardware-accelerated Matrix Multiplication kernel using AVX-512 and CUDA
body: Write hand-tuned AVX-512 SIMD assembly and CUDA kernel optimizing tensor core GEMM throughput.
rationale: Requires SIMD vector register scheduling, shared memory tiling, and warp shuffle optimization.

title: Resolve thread-pool starvation and priority inversion in real-time scheduler
body: High-priority audio processing threads get blocked by low-priority disk I/O workers causing buffer underruns.
rationale: Requires priority inheritance protocols, thread affinity tuning, and real-time POSIX scheduling.

title: Implement distributed transaction coordinator supporting Two-Phase Commit (2PC) with Paxos recovery
body: Design 2PC coordinator supporting distributed ACID transactions across heterogeneous databases with automatic Paxos recovery.
rationale: Requires distributed state durability, prepared transaction recovery, and crash-stop fault tolerance.

title: Implement custom bytecode virtual machine with register-based execution model
body: Build virtual machine that compiles AST into bytecode instructions with virtual registers and inline caching.
rationale: Requires opcode dispatch design, stack/register VM trade-offs, and dynamic type feedback.

title: Fix memory leak in JEMalloc custom allocator wrapper under cyclic reference load
body: Memory usage grows unbounded in long-running services due to fragmented heap arenas in custom memory allocator.
rationale: Requires heap profiling with heaptrack/jemalloc prof, arena analysis, and slab allocator tuning.

title: Implement secure cryptographic key derivation protocol resistant to side-channel timing attacks
body: Implement constant-time Argon2id password hashing and HKDF key derivation with hardware cache-flush defenses.
rationale: Requires constant-time execution verification, cache timing attack mitigation, and cryptographic audit.

title: Design fault-tolerant event sourcing replay engine with snapshot compaction
body: Build high-throughput event store that replays 100M events/sec with delta snapshots and distributed stream partition rebalancing.
rationale: Requires partitioned log storage, zero-allocation deserialization, and deterministic event replay.

title: Optimize garbage collection pause times in high-throughput streaming runtime
body: Tune generational GC, write barriers, and off-heap memory buffers to reduce P99 pause times below 2 milliseconds.
rationale: Requires deep JVM/V8/Go runtime internals, GC log analysis, and off-heap memory management.

title: Implement decentralized peer-to-peer DHT routing table based on Kademlia protocol
body: Build Kademlia DHT with XOR metric distance calculations, iterative node lookups, and bucket refresh routines.
rationale: Requires P2P networking protocols, UDP hole punching, and routing table convergence.

title: Fix typo in CONTRIBUTING guide link
body: The link to the contributor code of conduct has a broken anchor tag. Fix to point to #code-of-conduct.
rationale: Markdown link anchor fix.

title: Add test checking that divide by zero raises ZeroDivisionError
body: Write a simple unit test ensuring divide(10, 0) raises ZeroDivisionError.
rationale: Simple test case verifying expected standard exception.

title: Improve help message for --verbose flag
body: Clarify that -v specifies log level INFO while -vv enables DEBUG level in CLI help.
rationale: Improving command-line flag documentation.

body: Function is_valid_url is missing '-> bool' return type annotation.
rationale: Adding single return type hint.

title: Clean up redundant whitespace in markdown files
body: Markdown lint flags trailing whitespace on multiple lines in docs/index.md.
rationale: Cleaning up formatting and trailing whitespace.

title: Implement user avatar thumbnail generator with Pillow
body: When user uploads avatar, resize image to 128x128 thumbnail and save as optimized PNG.
rationale: Requires image manipulation with PIL, aspect ratio calculation, and storage.

title: Add database health check endpoint /healthz
body: Endpoint should execute 'SELECT 1' against database and return 200 OK or 503 Service Unavailable.
rationale: Requires database connection check, error handling, and JSON status formatting.

title: Support sorting products by price and popularity
body: Allow query params ?sort=price_asc, price_desc, or popularity on product catalog API.
rationale: Requires dynamic SQL/ORM order_by clauses and query param validation.

title: Add rate limit remaining headers to API responses
body: Inject X-RateLimit-Limit, X-RateLimit-Remaining, and X-RateLimit-Reset headers into outgoing API responses.
rationale: Requires response header manipulation and rate limit state inspection.

title: Implement CSRF token protection for HTML forms
body: Generate cryptographic CSRF token in session and validate hidden input field on form submission.
rationale: Requires session management, token comparison, and 403 response on mismatch.

title: Debug memory leak in CPython subinterpreter thread state
body: Thread state structures are not properly decref'd when destroying subinterpreters leading to memory leak.
rationale: Requires deep CPython C-API internals, GIL interactions, and thread-local storage.

title: Implement kernel-level eBPF packet filter for DDoS mitigation
body: Write XDP eBPF program that drops SYN flood packets at the network card driver level before sk_buff allocation.
rationale: Requires C eBPF kernel bytecode, BPF maps, and Linux network stack internals.

title: Design zero-allocation binary protocol serializer for IPC
body: Build zero-copy binary serializer with SIMD acceleration for low-latency inter-process communication.
rationale: Requires memory alignment, byte-order endianness handling, and SIMD instructions.

title: Implement distributed consensus view change protocol for Raft
body: Handle edge case where candidate node disconnects during leader election causing split vote deadlocks.
rationale: Requires formal state machine verification, election timer randomization, and network partition recovery.

title: Build custom JIT compiler backend targeting WebAssembly
body: Compile high-level domain specific language directly to WebAssembly binary format with stack machine code generation.
rationale: Requires binary Wasm encoding, type checking, and stack-based code generation.
